comments.author: ghengeveld
comments.body: Why not a single event and use payload to distinguish the action?

comments.author: ndelangen
comments.body:
Well they are distinct actions the user takes, so event-wise, it made sense to me.
Telemetry-wise they are all "share" events with an payload.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Phrased as a question but implies a suggestion to consolidate multiple events into a single event with a payload field.
